observations: body L2: «i e.» has no period after the i; kept as printed.
body L2-L3, L7, L11, L14, L23, L26-L27, L29, L31: the dashes of «’l–qāsim», «as–Samḥ», «al–Battānī», «az–Zarqālī», «al–Kha-», «’l–qarnayn» and «al–Ǵaghmīnī» are long dashes (4.6 to 5.6 pt).
body L18: the hyphen of «al-Ǵaghmīnī» measures 3.5 pt; «Auxilium» is set slightly spaced and is transcribed without letter-spacing.

body L4, L7: 1 muḥarram 416 is 3 March 1025 in the astronomers' reckoning (4 March in the civil one); the 145 Julian years from 880 to 1025 are 149.5 lunar years, which at 1° in 68 lunar years make 2° 12′.

body L5-L12: Ibn as-Samḥ's apogees less 2° 12′ give the numbers of L10, which agree with al-Battānī's of p. 114 (L11-L12 there) save Mars, printed 126° 18′ there (the addenda, Part I, p. LXXI, read 58′), and Venus, 82° 14′ there (cfr. L29-L30).
body L6: the sign of equality between ♀ and ⊙ is 9.6 pt long.
body L12, L23: the minutes are written in Arabic letters, يح 18 and نح 58, as in note 4 of p. 114: they differ by the two dots of the yā’ and the one of the nūn.

body L20-L28: al-Ǵaghmīnī's apogees less al-Battānī's of L10 give 4° 55′ 33″, for Mars 5° 35′ 46″ with 126° 18′ and 4° 55′ 46″ with 126° 58′. In al-Battānī's table of the motion of the fixed stars (Part II, p. 107) 320 years give 4° 50′ 55″, 5 years 4′ 33″ and 30 days 4″ 30‴, together 4° 55′ 32″ 30‴; 325 years and 30 days after 1 September 879 is 1 October 1204, and 1191 + 325 = 1516.
body L6, L26: specks before the closing quotation mark (L6) and under «1191» (L26) are not transcribed.
notes_left L1-L2: 18 raǵab 426 is 29 May 1035 in the civil reckoning.
notes_left L7: the dash of «1863–67» (about 4 pt, joined to the figures) is transcribed as a long dash.
notes_right L2: لح 38 and لج 33 differ by the dot of the jīm.
notes_right L5: the dash before «Codex» measures 6.7 pt.

notes_right L7-L10: the phrase of the Naples codex, لاول سنة عشر لذي القرنين, is divided after لاول; in letters 1307 is غشز and 1516 غثيو (1000 + 500 + 10 + 6). The lines of the right column stand about 15 pt apart (11.8 pt in the left column), as printed.
source_authority: Controlling master page image. Embedded text is not the authority for a reading.
transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
